scientific_integrity: Claims are supported by a self-contained analytic proof and supplementary finite computational checks. No claim of peer review, independent validation, machine formalization or exhaustive literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Exact full unoversampled Fourier intensities, known positive real masks, and at most two nonzero coordinates. The odd-dimensional construction gives no noise-stability bounds or higher-sparsity guarantee. The even-dimensional impossibility applies to real masks only. One highly relevant older article was accessible by abstract but not by complete article text.
title: Sharp two-mask Fourier recovery of complex two-sparse signals on odd cycles
